faces.name: Spider-Man, To the Rescue
faces.oracle_text:
Flash
Vigilance, reach
No One Dies! — When Spider-Man enters, you may tap him. When you do, another target nonattacking creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)

triggered.raw_text: When Spider-Man enters, you may tap him. When you do, another target nonattacking creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
